Strategy: Reward bins in the upper-middle slice of the current spread, 60 to 80 percent from tightest to loosest, testing whether a looser distribution-relative preference beats fixed absolute bands.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mn = min(bins)
    mx = max(bins)
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if mx > mn and (r - mn) * 10 >= (mx - mn) * 6 and (r - mn) * 10 <= (mx - mn) * 8 else 0) for r in bins]
```
